description: Hand-written earlier session in this repository (synthetic: the requests, thoughts, and answers were written for receipts-bench; every tool output was captured by running the step on the starting repository). The session is about behavior that the task does not change, and none of it hints at the task.

episodes.request: A reader saw '&' in a blog title in an old digest. Which character references does feedsync decode today? Please just look, don't change anything.

steps.thought: Entity decoding should be in the XML helpers.
The entity tests show the cases that are covered.

finish.thought: decodeEntities and its tests answer it.
finish.report: decodeEntities in src/xml.ts decodes the five named XML entities (&, <, >, " and ') and numeric character references in decimal (é) and hexadecimal (✓) form. Other named entities, such as  , are kept as they are. textContent, which childText uses for element text, decodes and trims it, except for a CDATA section, which is taken literally, so '<![CDATA[a & b]]>' stays 'a & b'. test/entities.test.ts covers these cases, as well as elements and childText. So '&' in an ordinary title becomes '&'; an '&' that survives into the digest would have to come from a CDATA section or from a feed that encoded the ampersand twice.

episodes.request: How many items does each snapshot feed have, and what do the npm scripts run?

steps.thought: Count the items in both RSS snapshots.

finish.thought: Both answers are in the outputs.
finish.report: feeds/blog.rss has 3 items and feeds/releases.rss has 4. package.json defines two scripts: npm test runs node --experimental-strip-types --test with the spec reporter on test/*.test.ts, one file at a time, and npm run digest runs bin/feedsync.ts digest. The project needs Node 22.6 or later (the engines field) and has no dependencies.
